values.note: Pay at the self-serve fee station; fees still required while the water is off.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/spring-creek-campground ('Single Site: $10 per night', Current Conditions 'No potable water available. Fees still required.'; last updated October 13, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Campsites cannot be reserved by simply paying for the site; camper must be present.'

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/spring-creek-campground ('All campgrounds on the Helena-Lewis and Clark National Forest are first-come, first-served. Reservations are not available. Camping is limited to 16 consecutive days in one location.'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/spring-creek-campground ('The 10 campsites', 'can only accommodate a maximum trailer length of 35 feet, and is not recommended for campers with large RVs'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'usually open from May through the middle of fall'; 'Open and close dates can vary depending on snowfall conditions.'

Drinking water: Current Conditions (page updated Oct 13, 2026) says 'No potable water available'; the forest's standard text says campgrounds have potable water 'during the warmer months' and the amenity list says it is available. ATV trailhead in the campground; OHVs must stay on the campground road; no horses.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/spring-creek-campground (Restrooms 'vault toilet'; Current Conditions; Water 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Helena-Lewis & Clark NF campground in a lush riparian zone along Spring Creek in the Little Belt Mountains, 26 mi E of White Sulphur Springs on US-12 then 4 mi N on Spring Creek Road (FR 274); picnic tables, fire rings, wading and fishing in the creek. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Oct 13, 2026): confirmed $10, 10 sites, 35-ft max trailer, first-come, vault toilet; added 16-day stay limit and a May-to-mid-fall season. Drinking water left as is (Current Conditions: none now; amenity list: available). Note trimmed of restated values. Alerts: forest-wide orders and a Park Lake closure elsewhere; nothing for Spring Creek.
flags: Criteria wording: the FS page says the campground 'can only accommodate a maximum trailer length of 35 feet, and is not recommended for campers with large RVs' (a 35-ft limit, so a 23-ft motorhome should fit; flagged because the wording is an explicit large-RV caution).

Missing phone: the campground page names no office. Per the forest's offices page (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/offices) the likely district is White Sulphur Springs RD (406) 547-3361 or Musselshell RD (Harlowton) (406) 632-4391; which one administers Spring Creek is not stated.
Drinking water: Current Conditions 'No potable water available' (Oct 2026) vs 'Potable water is available at this site'; derived potable_water: true left unchanged.
